name: Kimi wa Yasashiku Netorareru -Lustful betrayal-
original_name: キミはやさしく寝取られる -Lustful betrayal-
source:
Just three words, “I love you”—but I could never bring myself to tell her…

Between the friends I knew so well,
there lay a secret relationship I had never known about—

The pure-hearted protagonist, Haruta Fuyutsuki,
had always harbored feelings for his friend, Rio Inami.
He finally mustered up his courage and confessed his love,
and the two officially became a couple.
He was basking in happiness—

However, both Rio’s body and heart already belonged to someone else.

[From the [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/10380]official site[/url]]
translation:
只有三个字，“我爱你”——但我却无法告诉她……

在我如此熟悉的朋友之间，
那里存在着一种我从来不知道的秘密关系——

内心纯洁的主人公冬月春田，
他一直对他的朋友稻波里奥怀有感情。
他终于鼓起勇气表白了自己的爱情，
两人正式结为情侣。
他沉浸在幸福之中——

然而，里奥的身体和心灵都已经属于别人了。
